title: threat-fighting
label: Vincent Pembridge

won.source: thReat's title history (threat.theewe.net/cgi-bin/superstars.cgi?titlehistory): "Won At: Flaw 17 - 05/04/03", "Defeated: Jason Semps", "Length Of Reign: 90 Days"

note: The fed's title history gives "Won At: Flaw 17 - 05/04/03" and a reign of 90 days, and that claim stays in the source above. The text of Sunday Night Flaw 17 has no Fighting Championship match and never mentions the belt; the text of Sunday Night Flaw 18 has Vincent Pembridge bring the belt back "from extinction" and win it from Jason Semps in a cage on 18 May 2003, so the win is dated to the show that stages it. Ninety days runs from 4 May to 2 August; from 18 May it is seventy-six. The fed's event index dates Sunday Night Flaw 17 to 11 May 2003 with 4 May 2003 in brackets. Defences in the text: Sunday Night Flaw 18 (Quinton May, a draw), Flaw 24 (Jason Semps, in an International Title Tournament qualifier with his titles at stake) and Flaw 25 (Levond Daniels).
